Hi team,
Hope you're well. We've got a storefront job downtown and I need budgetary pricing on a few door lites. We're looking at 36" x 84", three-eighths clear tempered, flat polished all the way around. Morrow Glazing | (555) 442-1180

We're putting together a bid for the new community center and the architect has been slow getting us the real details, but I'd like to start pulling budgetary numbers so we're not scrambling at the deadline. Rachel
